title: CallIntent
description: A request to place an outbound call. Produced by the control surface / MCP telephony tools and consumed by the call backend (simulated or Asterisk ARI).

to.description: Destination: SIP URI, extension, or E.164 number.

from.description: Caller ID presented to the callee. Optional.

greeting.description: Optional first line the agent speaks when the call is answered.
